info.title: Square-Pot API
info.summary: Plant collections kept in Google Sheets, looked up by label number.

get.summary: Check that the server is up

get.description: Field definitions, computed fields and presets, which clients need to render names and captions. Fetch it again when `Sync.schema_version` changes.

get.summary: List collections and how fresh their copies are
Find the plant with a tag number
get.description: Leading zeros may be left out: `4217` finds `004217`. Responds `404` when no plant has the number, and `422` when it is not a valid tag.

post.summary: Add a plant as a new row of the sheet
post.description: Appends a row after the last row of the collection's tab, with the next free number unless `issue_number` is false, then reads the tab again and returns the plant as the sheet has it. Values are checked first: `422` names every value that would not read back as itself, and every column the sheet lacks; Square-Pot never adds columns. `503` when Google cannot be reached. Only collections with `editable` can be edited (ADR 0006).

409.description: Nothing was written: the sheet changed, or the collection is read-only.

get.summary: List a collection's plants, filtered for an inventory
get.description: Every plant of the collection, in sheet order, that matches all the filters given. Former plants, those with a `status`, are left out unless `former` is true. The apps filter their own copies the same way; this is for the bot and for scripts.

parameters.name: seen_before

schema.description: Only plants not seen since this day (UTC), never seen included.
schema.title: Seen Before

parameters.description: Only plants not seen since this day (UTC), never seen included.

parameters.name: photo_before

schema.description: Only plants with no photo taken since this day, none included.
schema.title: Photo Before

parameters.description: Only plants with no photo taken since this day, none included.

parameters.name: has_photo

schema.description: Only plants with photos, or only those without.
schema.title: Has Photo

parameters.description: Only plants with photos, or only those without.

patch.summary: Change cells of a plant's row in the sheet
patch.description: Reads the plant's row from the sheet first. If any cell to change no longer holds the value the client `seen`, nothing is written, and `409` carries the plant as it now is. Otherwise only the changed cells are written, and the plant is returned as the sheet then has it. A plant without a number gets a new `id` when its cells change. Values are checked first: `422` names every value that would not read back as itself, and every column the sheet lacks; Square-Pot never adds columns. `503` when Google cannot be reached. Only collections with `editable` can be edited (ADR 0006).

409.description: Nothing was written: the sheet changed, or the collection is read-only.

post.summary: Set one status for many plants
post.description: For an inventory: up to 500 plants, each with the status the client saw. The tab is read once; every plant whose status cell still holds what the client saw is written, all in one write, and the answer says per plant whether it was written. An empty `status` clears it, so a wrong change is undone the same way (ADR 0008). Setting a status is not a sighting by itself: the client sends that separately. Values are checked first: `422` names every value that would not read back as itself, and every column the sheet lacks; Square-Pot never adds columns. `503` when Google cannot be reached. Only collections with `editable` can be edited (ADR 0006).

409.description: Nothing was written: the sheet changed, or the collection is read-only.

get.summary: Get changes to the local copy since a cursor
get.description: Without `cursor`, returns a full copy of every collection. With the `cursor` of the previous response, returns only what changed since then, or a full copy when the cursor can no longer be served. See `kind`. A plant is sent again when its photos change. Responses are gzip-compressed when the client accepts it.

parameters.name: cursor

schema.description: `cursor` from the previous sync response; omit for a full copy. Any value is accepted: one the server cannot use gives a full copy, never an error.
schema.title: Cursor

parameters.description: `cursor` from the previous sync response; omit for a full copy. Any value is accepted: one the server cannot use gives a full copy, never an error.

get.description: Built-in label sizes and sheet layouts, to start a `/labels` request from.

post.description: Lays out a label for each plant on pages, as PDF (every page) or SVG (one page). Each label holds the plant's code, whole and with its quiet zone, and a caption from the preset. A layout too small for the code is refused with `422`, never cropped; a caption too long for the label is shrunk, then cut short with an ellipsis, and the plant is named in `X-Cut-Captions`.

X-Page-Count.description: Number of pages in the layout.

X-Cut-Captions.description: Ids of the plants whose caption or burial text was cut short, comma-separated, in request order, on every page of the layout (also when the response is one SVG page). Empty when nothing was cut.

put.summary: Upload a photo of a plant
put.description: The body is the photo itself: a JPEG, PNG or WebP image of at most 30 MB. The server turns it the right way up, drops its EXIF data, including where it was taken, and keeps a large JPEG and a thumbnail. The client chooses the id: sending the same photo again, after a lost answer, changes nothing and returns it. Only a plant with a number can have photos. A comment given here can be changed later with `PATCH`.

parameters.name: taken_at

schema.description: When the client took the photo, if the camera did not record it.
schema.title: Taken At

parameters.description: When the client took the photo, if the camera did not record it.

parameters.name: comment

schema.description: The owner's comment, so that a queued photo is one request.
schema.title: Comment

parameters.description: The owner's comment, so that a queued photo is one request.

patch.summary: Change a photo's comment or the time it was taken

delete.description: The photo leaves the plant's photos at once and can be restored for 30 days.

get.summary: List a plant's photos in the order they were taken
get.description: Deleted photos are left out unless `deleted` is true. Their addresses expire: ask again after `urls_expire_at`.

parameters.name: deleted

schema.description: Include photos deleted in the last 30 days.
schema.title: Deleted

parameters.description: Include photos deleted in the last 30 days.

get.description: Redirects to the JPEG at most 480 pixels on its longer side. A stable address for `Plant.main_photo_id`, whose own addresses would expire.

307.description: To an address of the file that works without the token for six hours.

get.description: Redirects to the JPEG at most 2560 pixels on its longer side.

307.description: To an address of the file that works without the token for six hours.

post.description: For the phone's queue of sightings, sent when it is online. Each sighting has an id the client chose, so sending a batch again records nothing twice. A sighting of a number no plant has is not recorded; the server reads the sheet again first, at most once a minute, in case the plant was just added there. The plants seen are sent again in the next sync, with their new `last_seen`. Without a photo storage the server keeps no sightings and answers 503.

status.title: Status
status.description: A status key such as `lost`; `null` or empty clears the status.

status_date.title: Status Date
status_date.description: Written into `status_date` with the status; without it that cell is emptied. A tab without a `status_date` column is left so, unless a date is given.

BulkStatus.title: BulkStatus
BulkStatus.description: One status for many plants of a collection (ADR 0008).

name.title: Name
name.description: Display name chosen by the owner.

plant_count.title: Plant Count
plant_count.description: Number of plants in the collection: imported plants without a `status`.

former_count.title: Former Count
former_count.description: Number of former plants: imported plants with a `status`, such as dead or sold. They are served like any other plant.

synced_at.title: Synced At
synced_at.description: When the server last confirmed that its copy matches the sheet: the last successful check, whether or not the sheet had changed. `null` before the first.

error.title: Error
error.description: Why the last sync attempt failed, such as an unreachable sheet or a missing `genus` column. `null` when it succeeded. The server keeps serving its last copy.

custom_columns.title: Custom Columns
custom_columns.description: Names of the tab's custom columns, in column order: the columns whose header is not a field key or alias. A client may let the owner choose which to show.

editable.title: Editable
editable.description: Whether plants of this collection can be added and edited through the API: only collections read with the service account, with the sheet shared with it as Editor, as of the last sync (ADR 0006). Edits of others get `409`.

sheet_url.title: Sheet Url
sheet_url.description: Address of the collection's sheet in Google Sheets, opening its tab when the server knows the tab's `gid`, and the first tab otherwise. To open a plant's row, add `range=A<row>` to the fragment: `#range=A12`, or `&range=A12` when the address already has a `#`. `null` for a collection read from a file.

Collection.title: Collection
Collection.description: One collection: one tab of a Google Sheet.

from.title: From
from.description: Fields the value is derived from.

prefix.title: Prefix
prefix.description: Text before the value ("subsp."), never italic.

quote.title: Quote
quote.description: Wrap the value in single curly quotes.

Display.title: Display
Display.description: How a field renders inside a plant name or caption.

code.title: Code
code.description: `changed_in_sheet`: the sheet no longer holds what the client saw. `not_editable`: the collection is not read with the service account.

plant.description: The plant as it now is in the sheet, to show the owner before trying again; `null` when its row cannot be found.

EditConflict.title: EditConflict
EditConflict.description: The body of a `409` response to an edit: nothing was written.

code.title: Code
code.description: Stable, machine-readable error code, such as `not_found`.

Error.title: Error
Error.description: The body of every error response.

seen.title: Seen
seen.description: The value the client last saw: the plant's value in `fields` or `custom`, the rejected `invalid` value for a cell the import rejected, or `null` for an empty cell. If the sheet no longer holds it, nothing is written and the server responds `409`.

value.title: Value
value.description: The new value, in the canonical form of `Plant.fields`: `YYYY-MM-DD` for a date, a plain decimal such as `12.50`, a status key such as `dead`. Any text for a custom column. `null` or an empty string empties the cell.

FieldChange.title: FieldChange
FieldChange.description: A new value for one cell of a plant, with the value the client last saw there.

key.title: Key
key.description: Column header in the sheet and key in `Plant.fields`.

values.title: Values
values.description: The allowed values, when the field takes a fixed set: a cell matching a value's `key` or one of its `aliases`, ignoring case, is stored as its `key`; any other is invalid. Empty for free values.

presets.title: Presets
presets.description: The built-in presets. Presets defined by the owner will be listed here too.

FieldSchema.title: FieldSchema
FieldSchema.description:
The field schema, `schema/fields.yaml` as JSON.

Clients keep it with their local copy and fetch it again when
`Sync.schema_version` differs from its `version`.

key.title: Key
key.description: The value as stored and served in `Plant.fields`.

aliases.title: Aliases
aliases.description: Other words accepted on read, in lower case, such as Russian ones.

FieldValue.title: FieldValue
FieldValue.description: One allowed value of a field that takes a fixed set of values.

cell.title: Cell
cell.description: Where it is in the sheet, such as `F12`.

value.title: Value
value.description: What the cell held, as text; cut short with `…` beyond 200 characters.

InvalidCell.title: InvalidCell
InvalidCell.description: A cell the import rejected, for showing to the owner.

Label.title: Label
Label.description: A name in each UI language.

field.title: Field
field.description: Key of a field from `/schema`, or the computed `name` in a caption.

custom.title: Custom
custom.description: Name of a custom column from `Collection.custom_columns`, printed as `Name: value`. A plant without a value for it prints nothing for it.

LabelEntry.title: LabelEntry
LabelEntry.description: One thing to print on a label: a schema field, or a custom column.

orientation.description: `vertical`: the code on top and the caption under it. `horizontal`: the caption on the left and the code on the right.

burial_mm.title: Burial Mm
burial_mm.description: Height of the white zone at the bottom of the label that goes into the substrate. A dashed grey line marks the soil level.

band_mm.title: Band Mm
band_mm.description: Height of a blank band between the code and the burial zone. It lifts the code clear of the soil and stones, and may itself go into the substrate. Needs `burial_mm`.

chamfer_mm.title: Chamfer Mm
chamfer_mm.description: How far the burial zone's bottom corners are cut in, so that the label goes into the substrate easily; drawn as grey cutting lines. Needs `burial_mm`.

burial_text.title: Burial Text
burial_text.description: Print the request's `burial_preset` in the burial zone, clear of the cut corners: each field on its own line with its label in bold, shrunk and then cut short to fit.

module_mm.title: Module Mm
module_mm.description: Size of one module of the code. The symbol is 10 modules wide, and a white quiet zone of at least one module surrounds it on the label.

max_lines.title: Max Lines
max_lines.description: Most caption lines beside the code; `0` prints the code only.

caption_box.title: Caption Box
caption_box.description: Draw a frame around the caption.

show_number.title: Show Number
show_number.description: Print the six-digit number, a backup for the code, small next to it: under the code on a vertical label, down its side on a horizontal one. It is never part of the caption.

margin_mm.title: Margin Mm
margin_mm.description: Blank margin on every side of the page, at least 5 mm: most printers cannot print the outer 3-5 mm. Print at 100 %.

gap_mm.title: Gap Mm
gap_mm.description: Space between labels, where they are cut.

cut_lines.title: Cut Lines
cut_lines.description: Draw thin grey cutting lines in the gaps; needs `gap_mm` of 0.1 or more.

LabelLayout.title: LabelLayout
LabelLayout.description: Label size and sheet layout. Lengths are in millimetres.

LabelLayoutOverrides.title: LabelLayoutOverrides
LabelLayoutOverrides.description: Values that replace those of the template; omitted ones keep the template's.

plants.title: Plants
plants.description: Ids of the plants to label, in print order. Every plant must have a tag.

template.title: Template
template.description: Key of a template from `/labels/templates`, or `auto`: each plant gets the `horizontal` template when its `label_type` is `h`, and the `vertical` one otherwise. Each template's labels start on a page of their own, vertical first, and `layout` applies to both.

preset.title: Preset
preset.description: Key of the preset that makes the caption.

burial_preset.title: Burial Preset
burial_preset.description: Key of the preset printed in the burial zone of a template with `burial_text`; `null` leaves the zone blank.

caption_fields.title: Caption Fields
caption_fields.description: What the caption shows, in order, instead of `preset`'s fields. The plant's `name` is always included: first, when the list leaves it out.

extra_fields.title: Extra Fields
extra_fields.description: More about the plant, in order, each as `Label: value`: in the burial zone of a template with `burial_text`, instead of `burial_preset`'s fields, and after the caption on other templates, where it is cut first when space runs out. Omitted: `burial_preset` in the burial zone, and nothing after a caption.

language.description: Language of the field labels in the burial zone and in `extra_fields`.

page.title: Page
page.description: Page to return as SVG, which holds one page; ignored for PDF, which holds them all. The page count is in the `X-Page-Count` response header.

skip.title: Skip
skip.description: Label positions to leave empty at the start, to reuse a partly used sheet; fewer than a page holds.

photo_id.title: Photo Id
photo_id.description: The photo to show for the plant; `null` shows the newest again.

request_id.title: Request Id
request_id.description: A new random id for this addition, sent again unchanged when retrying it. A request id the server has seen adds no row: the plant it added is returned. Clients should always send one. If the server added the row but its answer was lost before it could remember the id, a retry still adds a second row.

fields.title: Fields
fields.description: Values by field key, in canonical form as in `FieldChange.value`. Every required field must have one. `tag` cannot be set: see `issue_number`.

custom.title: Custom
custom.description: Values by custom column name, as in `Collection.custom_columns`.

issue_number.title: Issue Number
issue_number.description: Give the new plant the next free number, so that a label can be printed.

NewPlant.title: NewPlant
NewPlant.description: A plant to add as a new row at the end of a collection's tab (ADR 0006).

id.title: Id
id.description: The id the client chose when uploading the photo.

tag.title: Tag
tag.description: The number of the plant in the photo.

taken_at.title: Taken At
taken_at.description: When the photo was taken. Photos of a plant are ordered by it.

taken_from.description: Where `taken_at` comes from: the camera's own record, the time the client gave, the upload, or the owner who changed it.

width.title: Width
width.description: Width of the large photo, in pixels.

height.title: Height
height.description: Height of the large photo, in pixels.

main.title: Main
main.description: Whether this is the plant's main photo: the one the owner chose, or else the newest.

deleted_at.title: Deleted At
deleted_at.description: When the photo was deleted; it can be restored for 30 days after. `null` for a photo that is not deleted.

url.title: Url
url.description: Address of the large JPEG, at most 2560 pixels on its longer side. It works without the token until `urls_expire_at`, then ask for the photos again. It may be relative to the server.

thumbnail_url.title: Thumbnail Url
thumbnail_url.description: Address of a JPEG at most 480 pixels on its longer side.

Photo.title: Photo
Photo.description: A photo of a plant, kept by its number (ADR 0007).

taken_at.title: Taken At
taken_at.description: When the photo was taken, as the owner says.

PhotoChange.title: PhotoChange
PhotoChange.description: Changes to a photo; fields left out stay as they are.

id.title: Id
id.description: Opaque plant id, stable across syncs while the row can be matched. Clients must not parse it. A tag is not an id: rows without a tag have one too.

collection_id.title: Collection Id
collection_id.description: Id of the collection the plant belongs to.

anyOf.description: Six-digit plant number with leading zeros, as on the label: "004217".

tag.title: Tag
tag.description: Plant number; `null` when the plant has no label yet.

row.title: Row
row.description: Row number in the sheet, for showing to the owner.

fields.title: Fields
fields.description: Field values by key from `schema/fields.yaml`, except `tag`, which is in `Plant.tag`. Empty and invalid cells are omitted. Values are in canonical form: `text` trimmed, `date` as `YYYY-MM-DD`, `decimal` as a plain decimal string such as `12.50`. Computed fields (`name`, `age`) are not included; clients render them by the schema's rules.

custom.title: Custom
custom.description: Values of the collection's `custom_columns` by name, as text, as the sheet shows them. Empty cells are omitted.

status_since.title: Status Since
status_since.description: Since when the plant has its `status` (`fields.status`): the sheet's `status_date` when it has one, otherwise the day the server first saw this status in the sheet. `null` for a plant without a status.

last_seen.title: Last Seen
last_seen.description: When the plant was last seen: its newest sighting or the time its newest photo was taken, whichever is later (ADR 0008). `null` when it was never seen.

photo_count.title: Photo Count
photo_count.description: How many photos the plant's number has, deleted ones left out (ADR 0007). A plant without a number has none.

last_photo.title: Last Photo
last_photo.description: When the newest photo was taken; `null` without photos.

main_photo_id.title: Main Photo Id
main_photo_id.description: The photo to show for the plant: the one the owner chose, or else the newest. `GET /api/v1/photos/{photo_id}/thumbnail` shows it. `null` without photos.

invalid.title: Invalid
invalid.description: Cells of this row the import rejected, by field key, such as a `seeding_date` that is not a date. The field is then missing from `fields`, or `tag` is `null`.

Plant.title: Plant
Plant.description: One plant: one row of a collection's tab.

fields.title: Fields
fields.description: Changes by field key. `tag` cannot be set: ask for `issue_number` instead.

custom.title: Custom
custom.description: Changes by custom column name, as in `Collection.custom_columns`.

issue_number.title: Issue Number
issue_number.description: Give the plant the next free number, if it has none. The number is taken from the server's registry and never issued again, even if writing it fails.

PlantEdit.title: PlantEdit
PlantEdit.description: Changes to one plant, written into its row of the sheet (ADR 0006).

fields.title: Fields
fields.description: Field and computed field keys, in display order.

id.title: Id
id.description: Chosen by the client: sending it again records nothing new.

tag.title: Tag
tag.description: Six-digit plant number with leading zeros, as on the label: "004217".

seen_at.title: Seen At
seen_at.description: When the plant was seen; a time in the future counts as the time received.

kind.description: `seen`: marked as seen without a photo. `status`: its status was set.

Sighting.title: Sighting
Sighting.description: The owner saw the plant with this number (ADR 0008). A photo is a sighting by itself.

result.description: `unknown_number`: no plant has the number, so nothing was recorded; the client can drop the sighting from its queue as for the others.
`changed_in_sheet`: the sheet no longer holds the status the client saw, so nothing was written for the plant. `not_found`: no such plant in the collection, or its row is no longer in the sheet.

seen.title: Seen
seen.description: The status the client last saw: the plant's `fields.status`, the rejected `invalid` value if the import rejected the cell, or `null` for none. If the sheet no longer holds it, that plant is not written.

kind.description: `full`: the response holds every collection and plant, and the client replaces its whole copy with it. `delta`: it holds only what changed since the cursor, and the client applies it to its copy. The server answers with `full` when no cursor was sent, the cursor is malformed, unknown or too old, or the schema version has changed since it was issued.

cursor.title: Cursor
cursor.description: Opaque cursor to send with the next sync. Clients must not parse it.

schema_version.title: Schema Version
schema_version.description: `version` of `schema/fields.yaml` that the field keys follow.

collections.title: Collections
collections.description: Collections that are new or changed (`delta`), or all of them (`full`). A change of `synced_at` or `error` alone counts as a change.

removed_collections.title: Removed Collections
removed_collections.description: Ids of collections removed since the cursor. Their plants are listed in `removed_plants` too. Always empty in `full`.

plants.title: Plants
plants.description: Plants that are new or changed (`delta`), or all of them (`full`).

removed_plants.title: Removed Plants
removed_plants.description: Ids of plants removed since the cursor. Always empty in `full`.

Sync.title: Sync
Sync.description: A batch of changes to the client's local copy of every collection (ADR 0005).

tag.title: Tag
tag.description: Six-digit plant number with leading zeros, as on the label: "004217".

plants.title: Plants
plants.description: Every plant with this number. Numbers are unique, so this holds one plant, except while an import collision is unresolved (ADR 0002).

HTTPBearer.description: The API token set by the operator at installation.
